author: mark
text:
README: split user quickstart from contributor setup

Hoist Quickstart and Install to the top so a public visitor sees
user-facing instructions first. Group contributor-only material
(make install-hooks, build targets, bl workflow, pre-commit hook)
under a Contributing section that opens with a one-line note that
none of it is required to use lernie.

Pure restructure of existing prose; no new terms of art, no doc
references changed. All gates green: make ci passes (fmt-check,
lint, 100% coverage); referenced paths still resolve.
